questions.question: A conical storage vessel stands vertex-down with a fixed height of $6\,\text{m}$ and a top radius of $3\,\text{m}$. Water is pumped in so that the volume of water increases at a constant rate of $8\pi\,\text{m}^3\text{/min}$. At any instant the water surface forms a similar cone. Let $h$ metres be the depth of the water.
questions.guidance: Use $V=\frac{\pi h^3}{12}$ from similar triangles ($r=h/2$). Then $\frac{dV}{dt}=\frac{\pi h^2}{4}\frac{dh}{dt}$.

answerParts.label: a) Find $\frac{dh}{dt}$ when the water depth is $4\,\text{m}$.
b) Hence find $\frac{dh}{dt}$ when the depth is $5\,\text{m}$, with the inflow rate unchanged.

questions.question: A drone's height above a flat runway (in metres) is modelled by $h(t)=t^3-9t^2+24t$ for $0\le t\le 6$, where $t$ is the time in seconds after take-off.
questions.guidance: $h'(t)=3(t-2)(t-4)$. The first local maximum on $(0,6)$ occurs at $t=2$. After that, solve $h(t)=18$ for the first time on the descent.

answerParts.label: a) Find the value of $t$ at the first local maximum of $h$ on the interval $(0,6)$.
b) After reaching this local maximum, the drone descends. Find the first time (in seconds) when its height is again $18\,\text{m}$.

questions.question: In a manufacturing line, the number of defective items in a random batch of $25$ units is modelled by $D\sim B(25,0.08)$. Each batch is independent.
The outside temperature (in $^\circ\text{C}$) at a remote station $t$ hours after midnight is modelled by $T(t)=-5+12\cos\!\left(\frac{\pi(t-4)}{12}\right)$ for $0\le t\le 24$.
questions.guidance: At $t=10$ the cosine argument is $\pi/2$. The minimum occurs when $\cos(\cdot)=-1$, giving $\frac{\pi(t-4)}{12}=\pi$.

answerParts.label: b) Find the time of day (hours after midnight) of the first minimum temperature after midnight.

questions.question: A rail-mounted sensor moves in a straight line. Its velocity is $v(t)=3t^2-24t+45\,\text{m/s}$ for $0\le t\le 6$, where $t$ is in seconds. The sensor starts at the origin, so its displacement $s(t)$ satisfies $s(0)=0$.
questions.guidance: $s(t)=t^3-12t^2+45t$. Solve $v(t)=0$ to find when the sensor is momentarily at rest, then evaluate $s(t)$ at those times.

answerParts.label: a) Find the displacement (in metres) at the first instant when the sensor is at rest.
b) Find the displacement at the next instant when the sensor is at rest.
